# elevenlabs_convai_agent (Resource)

Manages an ElevenLabs ConvAI agent. Supports full CRUD including ASR, TTS, LLM prompt, data collection, webhooks, and privacy/guardrail settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the agent. Must be unique within the workspace.
